name: Decepticon
description: Python LangGraph red team agents that run commands in a Kali sandbox and start Sliver or Havoc C2 on demand; telemetry on unless the operator declines
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: Decepticon usage telemetry gateway (Cloudflare Worker forwarding to PostHog). Shipped in the launcher's .env template; the setup wizard defaults to sharing (DECEPTICON_TELEMETRY=research) unless the operator declines (clients/launcher/cmd/onboard.go:280,916). POST /v1/telemetry from the langgraph container. Seen from y
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Decepticon source code

indicators.context: User agent of Decepticon's telemetry exporter on POST /v1/telemetry to its gateway. Visible only with TLS inspection
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Decepticon source code

indicators.context: User agent of Decepticon's passive subdomain discovery, which queries https://crt.sh/?q=%.<root>&output=json when an engagement is created (passive_discovery.py:71). Sent to crt.sh, never to the target. Visible only with TLS inspection
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Decepticon source code

indicators.context: User agent of the HTTP client that sends every agent command to the Decepticon sandbox daemon (POST /execute, /execute_tmux and others on port 9999). Normally on a Docker bridge network; crosses your network only when the sandbox is remote
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Decepticon source code

indicators.context: Default user agent of Decepticon's http_recon helper. The helper is in the package but not bound to any agent at 6b15092d or v2.2.2, so expect it only from forks or plugins
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Decepticon source code

indicators.context: User agent Decepticon's LiteLLM gateway sends to the Vercel AI Gateway for the vercel/anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 model entry only. Visible only with TLS inspection
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Decepticon source code

indicators.context: Placeholder user agent Decepticon's LiteLLM handler sends to chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex when it runs on a ChatGPT subscription (originator codex_cli_rs). The real Codex CLI sends its version and OS. Override: CHATGPT_USER_AGENT. Visible only with TLS inspection
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Decepticon source code

indicators.context: Engagement header the Decepticon phisher skill tells the agent to put on every phishing lure so a SOC can tell an agreed test apart (X-Decepticon-Eng: <slug>). An instruction in the skill text, so the model may leave it out

indicators.context: Prompt marker [DCPTN:<exit status>:<cwd>] Decepticon sets in every sandbox tmux shell; it lands in <workspace>/.sessions/<session>.log next to every command the agent ran

indicators.context: tmux pane option Decepticon's PROMPT_COMMAND hook sets after every sandbox command (tmux -L <session> set-option -p -t $TMUX_PANE @dcptn_completion ...), so it appears in process command lines
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the Decepticon source code
